answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so identities must provide sustained, reciprocal honest service to retain influence; a brief burst of activity cannot buy durable trust. In the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned sybils such as umber and raven begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality, and glacier-like persistence matters only when peers validate it through trusted links. They therefore lack the weight to pass consensus thresholds.
